rho_convention: labelled unary root; original edges retain their bottom-node or cluster identity
negative_checks: bad normalization fixture must fail AF validation
omitting active containment must admit the known invalid fixture
pretending the LCA parent exists in the root fixture must be rejected
acceptance: Every expected Boolean and exact cut/block count must match, with no tolerance. A root-boundary census counts only executed premises with an absent LCA-parent and at least two path cuts. Counterexamples must satisfy actual AF/component compatibility; standalone-domain failures do not refute the valid-active-state target.
